We are submitting this filing as required by the Hearing Officer’s ruling, but we maintain the objections stated in our initial Motion to Amend the Procedural Schedule and the appeal of the Hearing Officer’s ruling. We have worked diligently to attempt to prepare this testimony within the expedited time frame given to us, but given the lack of any responses to our information requests and the delay in receiving the Confidential versions of the Companies’ petitions, we maintain that our procedural rights have been severely prejudiced.
